name: Estated API
tagline: U.S. parcel-level property, owner, tax, and deed data via a simple REST lookup
description: Estated Property Data API v4 returns a single property record (address, parcel, structure, taxes, assessments, valuation, owner, deeds, optional boundary) for a U.S. address or FIPS+APN. Estated is part of ATTOM Data Solutions; production still runs at apis.estated.com and existing API keys remain valid during migration, while Estated docs and account portal are being deprecated in favor of ATTOM.

auth.details: API key as query param token= on every GET (e.g. ?token=YOUR_API_KEY). Separate sandbox key required for https://sandbox.estated.com/v4/property. Keys managed in Estated account (login); migrating to ATTOM Developer Portal. Self-serve /register and /account/signup currently 404.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Sandbox API for integration tests only (120 curated properties; separate sandbox key; not billed). Production free-tier limits not currently published; public pricing page is gone and self-serve signup URLs return 404 as of Aug 2026.
pricing.paid_plans: Not publicly listed on estated.com now (pricing page 404). Marketing: flexible volume-based pricing via ATTOM; contact ATTOM. Successful property matches are billable per docs.

rate_limits: not published (docs define RE04 when requests are throttled for high volume; no numeric RPM/RPD in current docs)
use_cases: look up parcel, structure, and tax data for a U.S. street address
get current assessed owner and mailing address for a property
fetch recent deed/sale history for an address or FIPS+APN
enrich an address with valuation and assessment values
resolve FIPS and APN candidates when an address matches multiple parcels
run integration tests against the free Sandbox property endpoint
